title: Crash with a class named Event
body:
```php
<?php
class Event {}
class AClass
{
    public function get(): Event
    {
        return new Event;
    }
}
```
Crashes Psalm with the following exception trace:
```
PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught UnexpectedValueException: Cannot get method params for  in /home/weirdan/.composer/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/MethodChecker.php:45
Stack trace:

#1 /home/weirdan/.composer/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/Expression/CallChecker.php(1522): Psalm\Checker\FunctionLikeChecker::getMethodParamsById(Object(Psalm\Checker\ProjectChecker), 'Event::__constr...', Array)
#2 /home/weirdan/.composer/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/Expression/CallChecker.php(557): Psalm\Checker\Statements\Expression\CallChecker::checkMethodArgs('Event::__constr...', Array, NULL, Object(Psalm\Context), Object(Psalm\CodeLocation), Object(Psalm\Checker\StatementsChecker))
#3 /home/weirdan/.composer/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/Statements/ExpressionChecker.php(186): Psalm\Checker\Statements\Expression\CallChe in /home/weirdan/.composer/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Checker/MethodChecker.php on line 45
```
